name: silicon-skills
description: Eleven measured agent skills for open-silicon, embedded firmware and edge AI: synthesisable Verilog/SystemVerilog, testbench discipline, timing closure and CDC, OpenLane 2 / Sky130 RTL-to-GDSII, ISR-safe Cortex-M firmware and MISRA C, ESP32/M5Stack provisioning, modern C++ and GoogleTest, latency-critical systems, INT8 quantisation to TFLite Micro, and the eval harness they are all graded by.
